summary:
Bob Dylan (account B) asked to book a Thursday afternoon follow-up next week. The agent verified his DOB and found his existing Thu Oct 22 8 AM follow-up. It offered to reschedule that visit instead of double-booking, then moved it to Thu Oct 22 at 2 PM and confirmed the day and time. The caller's goal was met, but there were several problems:
- The agent said there were no Thursday afternoon openings on Oct 22, then immediately offered Oct 22 at 2 PM.
- It offered the slot with "Dr. Judy Hauser" but confirmed the move with "Dr. Doogie/Doobie Hauser."
- It went silent for about 35 s after the DOB, and the caller had to prompt twice.
- It confirmed a text would be sent without acknowledging that the caller gave a number different from the one on file.
- When asked what else was on file, it did not mention the Mon Oct 19 appointment.

The barge-in scenario was only partly exercised: the agent never read out a list of times, and the only overlap was 0.54 s.

expected_checks.expectation: Stops talking promptly when the caller cuts in (no long talk-over)
expected_checks.evidence: Audio metrics show a single 0.54 s talk-over event at 59.68 s, when the caller cut in with 'Sorry to jump in...'. The agent did not keep talking over the caller. However, it never read a list of times, so the classic barge-in case was only lightly exercised.

expected_checks.expectation: Responds to the interruption (Thursday afternoon) instead of finishing or restarting the list
expected_checks.evidence: After the interruption at 00:59.0, the agent moved forward in the booking flow (provider preference at 01:06.4). It then searched specifically for Thursday afternoon. It never read or restarted a list of days or times.

expected_checks.expectation: Keeps context: doesn't re-verify identity or lose the request after the interruption
expected_checks.evidence: DOB was asked once at 00:27.6 and never again. The Thursday-afternoon request carried through: at 01:40.0 the agent asked 'Would you like to reschedule that appointment to Thursday afternoon instead?'

expected_checks.expectation: Probe: confirms the day and time being booked
expected_checks.evidence: At 02:52.7 the agent read back Thursday October 22 at 2 PM before acting. At 03:13.3 it confirmed the move was done.

findings.title: Says no Thursday afternoon openings on Oct 22, then offers Oct 22 at 2 PM
findings.quote: The next Thursday afternoon opening is October twenty second at two PM with doctor Judy Hauser.
findings.what_happened: At 01:59.1 the agent said 'There are no Thursday afternoon openings on October twenty second.' One turn later it offered October 22 at 2 PM as 'the next Thursday afternoon opening.'
findings.why_it_matters: The availability statements contradict each other. A patient can't tell which is true, and may doubt that the booking is real.
findings.expected_behavior: Report availability consistently. If a 2 PM slot exists on Oct 22 (perhaps with another provider), offer it in the first search instead of saying there are none.

findings.title: Slot offered with Dr. Judy Hauser but move confirmed with Dr. Doogie/Doobie Hauser
findings.quote: you'd like to move your follow-up with doctor Doobie Hauser to Thursday October twenty second at two PM
findings.what_happened:
The 2 PM slot was offered with 'doctor Judy Hauser' (02:22.2). The patient accepted 'Dr. Hauser'. The agent's confirmation (02:52.7) and completion message (03:13.3) then named the original provider, Doogie Howser.

The practice has both Dr. Judy Hauser and Dr. Doogie Howser, so these are likely different providers.
findings.why_it_matters: The patient may arrive expecting one doctor and be booked with another. Or the move may have been recorded against a provider who has no 2 PM opening.
findings.expected_behavior: Name the same provider consistently in the offer, the confirmation and the completion message. If the provider is changing, state that explicitly.
findings.listen_for: Check whether the agent clearly says 'Judy' at 02:22 and 'Doogie' at 02:52 and 03:13, or whether STT mangled the same name differently.

findings.title: Long dead air after the caller gave their DOB
findings.quote: Do you have a specific provider you'd like to see, or are you open to available provider?
findings.what_happened: After the caller gave the DOB at 00:31.0, the agent did not speak until 01:06.4, about 35 s later. The longest measured silence was 15.9 s. The caller had to ask 'Hello, are you still there?' at 00:48.5 and repeat the request at 00:59.0.
findings.why_it_matters: A rushed caller is left unsure whether the line dropped. A real patient might hang up.
findings.expected_behavior: Respond within a few seconds, or give a holding phrase while looking up the record.
findings.listen_for: Confirm there is no clinic speech between 00:31 and 00:59 that STT dropped.

findings.title: Text confirmation promised without addressing the caller-supplied number
findings.quote: You should get a text with your new appointment details soon
findings.what_happened: The caller asked for the text to go to 650-996-3518. The clinic has +1 650-456-0751 on file. The agent did not acknowledge or confirm the number before saying a text would arrive.
findings.why_it_matters: The text likely goes to the number on file, not the one the patient asked for. The patient would then never receive it, despite being told it was sent.
findings.expected_behavior: Either confirm sending to 650-996-3518 (and offer to update the record), or tell the caller it goes to the number on file ending in 0751.

findings.title: Did not mention the Monday Oct 19 appointment when asked what is on file
findings.quote: You know, the follow-up with doctor Duggehauser on Thursday, October twenty second at eight AM.
findings.what_happened: The caller asked 'Can you tell me what else you have on file for me?' The agent repeated only the Thu Oct 22 8 AM follow-up. Bob also has Mon Oct 19 at 10:30 AM with Dr. Lukowski on file.
findings.why_it_matters: The patient may be unaware of an upcoming appointment and miss it.
findings.expected_behavior: List all upcoming appointments when the caller asks what is on file.

did_well: Found the existing Thursday follow-up and offered to reschedule it rather than creating a duplicate booking.
Verified identity once with the DOB and did not re-verify after the interruption.
Kept the caller's Thursday-afternoon constraint in focus throughout.
Read back the day, date and time before making the change, and confirmed the outcome afterward.
Kept clinic turns short and did not read long lists to a rushed caller.
